notes.title: We changed contents of the game.
notes.notes:
We changed this game to a score attack type game where the hero who came to play in the shopping district aimed at how much shopping street can be enjoyed before going home.
(But, since the hero loves playing games at home, he will soon get home.)

notes.title: The game system was renewed.
notes.notes:
Simply walking around the city while talking is very boring, so We changed the game system.
We introduced a rule to shorten the time of one play so that you can earn a higher score within a given condition.
